thread:
alex: Morning — quick triage snapshot. Overnight volume 42 (↑8 vs yesterday). Top buckets: billing double-charge (3 tickets), embeddings duplicate on ingest (5), transient latency spike in eu-west-1 affecting inference jobs. I've updated the KB macros with a small wording fix. Assigning: billing -> sam, embeddings -> maria, latency -> kevin. Reply with blockers.

triage-bot: automated summary — total: 42 | p1:1 | p2:7 | backlog:34 | new:8

sam: on billing. I'll triage the 3 duplicate-charge tickets now. If any of them involve refunds >$500 escalate to finance. tagging @eng-platform for any refund automation issues.

maria: taking embeddings. I reproduced a duplicate embed case locally — seems related to newline-normalization in the preprocessor. Repro steps below:
```bash
# repro (local)
curl -X POST https://ingest.internal/api/v1/doc -d @sample_with_trailing_newline.json 
# then check embeddings with: 
curl https://internal/api/v1/embedding/lookup?id=<doc_id>
```
Found duplicates when doc ends with "\\n\\n" and batch dedupe didn't catch it.

jordan: PR #678 touches the support macro templates (cleans up variables). I pushed a follow-up to ensure refund tokens render. Need a quick review / approval so alex's KB edits don't conflict.

alex: jordan — can you hold off merging until we confirm the refund token interpolation with finance? Also here's the exact macro edit I made — want to keep wording consistent:
```text
Title: Billing - duplicate charge refund
Response:
Hi <customer>, sorry about the duplicate charge. We've issued a refund of $<amount>.
Steps: refund_id: {{refund_id}} | ETA: 3-5 business days
Note: ensure `refund_id` is populated by the finance webhook before sending.
```
Please review and confirm.

kevin: looking into the eu-west-1 latency spike. Early signs point to intermittent GPU queueing on a minority of nodes after a nightly batch. Scrubbing logs now — see sample below:
```log
2026-03-17T01:12:03Z gpu-svc[worker-12]: queue_wait_ms=1250 model_load=ok
2026-03-17T01:12:05Z gpu-svc[worker-12]: kvcache_miss=0.02 batching_delay_ms=700
```
If I see >2s queue_wait I'll reroute traffic to eu-west-2.

sam: quick Q — for refunds, do we have a macro that includes the refund transaction link? Finance prefers the link in the response. If not, we should add it. :thinking_face:

jordan: I'll add the refund link variable in PR #678 ({{refund_link}}) and include a safety check so the macro doesn't send without `refund_id` and `refund_link`.

maria: temporary mitigation for embeddings: I pushed a small dedupe prehook to staging that normalizes trailing whitespace. If we want, I can backport to production after one more smoke test.

alex: please smoke test and post results here. If green, we'll schedule a quick rolling deploy to prod at 09:30 UTC.

maria: smoke test passed on staging (10/10 docs normalized). Will schedule deploy at 09:20 UTC and monitor.

kevin: continuing to monitor latency, will open an infra ticket if reroute needed.

alex: thanks everyone. Action items: sam -> refund review & add link macro if needed; jordan -> finish PR lint + refund link; maria -> deploy dedupe backport; kevin -> keep latency watch and escalate if >2s. Hold macro freeze until jordan confirms merge (alex to approve). :thumbsup:

triage-bot: handoff reminder — next triage lead @sam at 08:00 UTC.
